label: MBM basket - food (reference family, per year)
description: Food: the cost of a nutritious diet (per the National Nutritious Food Basket) prepared at home. Annual cost for the MBM reference family (2 adults + 2 children; Nunavut: 2 adults + 3 children), current dollars for the observation year, 2023-base MBM. To approximate other household sizes, StatCan's MBM uses a square-root equivalence scale: the cost for a household of n persons is the reference-family cost x sqrt(n/referenceHouseholdSize), where the reference is 4 people, or 5 in Nunavut; e.g. 1 person = 50%, 2 persons = 71%, 3 persons = 87%, 5 persons = 112%. Published family-size totals in table 11-10-0104-01 follow this scale.
